notes.title: February 2nd Update Log
notes.notes:
We have added a runtime log feature to the main menu, which will save the logs from your last 10 game sessions.

If you encounter any save file crashes, you can contact us immediately through QQ Group: 362056093. We will do our best to analyze the bugs in the save file and assist you in recovering it. We guarantee that it is highly likely to be recoverable—yes, it’s incredibly frustrating to crash right when you want to take a break after spending an hour in an endless run!

See you in the next update~
